entries.title: Signing in to Google is enough
entries.body: Infinitary no longer asks you to approve the Google sign-in you just made before it keeps Gmail and Calendar working. Settings → Secrets still lists it, says Infinitary keeps it for you, and offers Manage in Integrations instead of Replace and Forget.

picture.alt: Settings → Secrets with the Google sign-in row open, saying Infinitary keeps it for a sign-in made in Integrations, with a Manage in Integrations button
